details.description: Jamba 1.5 Mini is AI21 Labs' smaller Jamba 1.5 model, a hybrid SSM-Transformer (Joint Attention and Mamba) model with 12B active parameters out of 52B total, released August 22, 2024 alongside Jamba 1.5 Large. It shares the family's 256K-token context window and is positioned for lower-latency, cost-efficient enterprise chat, RAG and agentic tasks, with function calling, JSON-formatted output, and document-based grounded generation with citations. AI21 has since released Jamba Mini 1.7, and Hugging Face marks this 1.5 Mini snapshot as superseded by that newer version.
advantages: AI21 reports an Arena Hard score of 46.1, which it describes as the strongest open model in its size class, ahead of Mixtral 8x22B and Command-R+ (AI21 launch post).
Shares the family's 256K-token context window, with AI21 reporting 86.1% effective context length retention at 256K tokens on the RULER benchmark (Hugging Face model card).
Supports function calling, JSON-formatted structured output, and document-based grounded generation with citations (Hugging Face model card).
disadvantages: Hugging Face displays a banner marking this card superseded, pointing to a newer version, AI21-Jamba-Mini-1.7 (Hugging Face model card).
Amazon Bedrock lists this model's lifecycle status as Legacy, with an end-of-life date of November 26, 2026 (Amazon Bedrock model card).
Knowledge cutoff of March 2024 (Hugging Face model card).
use_cases: Low-latency enterprise chat and customer support
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with grounded, cited responses over long documents
Agentic workflows using function calling and structured JSON output
Cost-efficient long-document summarization using the 256K-token context window

sources.title: Jamba 1.5 Mini - Amazon Bedrock model card

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens (256000) is kept as authoritative per instructions, but Amazon Bedrock's own model card lists 'Max output tokens: 4K' for this model on Bedrock -- flagging the mismatch. Catalog's deprecation_date (2026-11-26) matches Amazon Bedrock's 'Model EOL date' exactly. A Hugging Face banner marks this specific 1.5 Mini card superseded by AI21-Jamba-Mini-1.7; a date given on that banner for a 'deprecation' (May 6, 2024) predates the model's own August 22, 2024 launch date and looks like a page-scraping artifact, so it was not used.
